create_rectanguloid: create a solid rectanguloid with specified width, height, and depth dimensions
create_hollow_rectanguloid: create a hollow rectanguloid with configurable wall thickness and optional labels
create_sphere: create a solid sphere with a given radius and optional labeling
create_spherical_shell: create a hollow spherical shell with configurable radius and wall thickness
arrange_shapes: arrange schematic shapes in a circle or line pattern with offsets
